info.title: TopMessage Universal API
info.description: Send and retrieve SMS and WhatsApp messages, manage messaging workflows, and track message activity with TopMessage.

get.description: Retrieves a message by ID from TopMessage.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.description: The unique identifier of the TopMessage message to retrieve.

data.description: The message returned by TopMessage for the requested message ID.
